title: PawaCast shared meter-data record
description: Public site-month statistics from operator meter data. Exact coordinates, meter IDs, and per-customer kWh never appear. k-anonymity requires true n_customers >= 25 (published n is rounded to the nearest 5). Laplace noise is added with per-release epsilon; monthly releases compose under basic composition to yearly_epsilon_budget.

h3_res6.description: H3 cell at resolution 6 (~36 km²). Exact lat/lon never published.

month.description: Calendar month of the aggregated readings (UTC month start, YYYY-MM).

months_since_power_on.description: Whole months from the site power-on date to this month.

n_customers.description: Active customer meters this month, rounded to the nearest 5. Records with true n < 25 are rejected (raised from 10 because Laplace |noise| at n=10 with clip 20 kWh is 40% of a typical 5 kWh mean).

mean_kwh_cust.description: Mean kWh per active customer meter per month, after Laplace noise.

p10_kwh_cust.description: 10th percentile of per-customer monthly kWh, after Laplace noise.

p50_kwh_cust.description: Median of per-customer monthly kWh, after Laplace noise.

p90_kwh_cust.description: 90th percentile of per-customer monthly kWh, after Laplace noise.

business_share.description: Share of active customers that are businesses, rounded to the nearest 10%.

proof_ref.description: Reference to a Compact/Midnight proof that the exact (pre-noise) sum and count match a prior commitment. Demo records use a demo: prefix and are not on-chain. The published noised mean is not what is proven.

commitment.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the exact per-customer millikWh vector that the proof is checked against. Published before noise. 32 bytes.

epsilon.description: Per-release differential-privacy budget for Laplace noise on this month's published kWh statistics (and business share). One record = one monthly release.

epsilon_period.description: Cadence of one epsilon spend. Monthly releases compose under basic composition: 12 releases of epsilon spend yearly_epsilon_budget.

yearly_epsilon_budget.description: Basic composition of 12 monthly releases: yearly_epsilon_budget = 12 × epsilon. Operators who publish every month spend the full yearly budget.

kwh_clip.description: Per-customer monthly kWh clip before statistics. Sensitivity of the mean is kwh_clip/n. Set to 20 (Renewvia TRAIN site-month means sit below this).

label.description: Human-readable provenance. Demo TRAIN records use the Renewvia CC BY-SA 4.0 label.
